stories.title: Rector Cornell belooft maatregelen na aanklacht groepsverkrachting

en.title: Cornell rector promises measures after gang rape allegation
en.summary: The rector of Cornell University announced measures in response to allegations of gang rape by students in 2024, involving a woman who was allegedly drugged and assaulted for hours. An independent investigation into the matter will be conducted.

stories.title: Pro-Europese premier wint verkiezingen Letland ruimer dan verwacht

en.title: Pro-European premier wins Latvia elections by larger margin than expected
en.summary: Latvia's pro-European premier Andris Kulberg won yesterday's election with a stronger margin than anticipated, securing 36.5 percent of votes. His party ruled out cooperation with pro-Russian parties to form a government.

stories.title: Rector Cornell University belooft maatregelen na heropening zaak groepsverkrachting

en.title: Cornell rector promises measures after reopening of gang rape case
en.summary: The rector of Cornell University announced measures following the reopening of a gang rape case involving students at the institution.

stories.title: Rector Cornell belooft beterschap na aanklacht groepsverkrachting door studenten

en.title: Cornell rector promises improvement after student gang rape allegation
en.summary: Cornell University's rector expressed deep distress over allegations of student gang rape and acknowledged the university's inadequate response, pledging to do better. He addressed concerns about sexual violence, hazing culture, and substance abuse.

stories.title: Gevangenistopman Tennessee weg na mislukte executie Christa Pike

en.title: Tennessee prison chief resigns following failed execution of Christa Pike
en.summary: The director of Tennessee's prison system is stepping down this month following a failed execution, though he maintains procedures were followed correctly. An independent investigation into what went wrong is underway.

stories.title: Centrumpartij van Letse premier Andris Kulbergs de grootste in exitpolls, pro-Russische partijen kleiner dan verwacht

en.title: Exit polls show Latvian Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs' centrist party leading, pro-Russian parties underperform
en.summary: Exit polls indicate Kulbergs' party significantly outperformed the right-populist Latvia First party. A shift toward a pro-Russian government appears unlikely based on these results.

stories.title: Politie houdt man aan na dodelijke schietpartij bij bar Amsterdam

en.title: Police arrest man after fatal shooting at Amsterdam bar
en.summary: A 32-year-old man was arrested following a fatal shooting near Vondelpark in Amsterdam. A 34-year-old resident was shot outside bar Sao Paulo; police have not confirmed whether the arrested man is the shooter.

stories.title: Exitpolls: pro-Oekraïense partij van Letse premier Kulbergs wint verkiezingen

en.title: Exit polls: pro-Ukrainian party of Latvian Prime Minister Kulbergs wins election
en.summary: Exit polls show that the pro-Ukrainian party led by Latvian Prime Minister Kulbergs has won the election.

stories.title: Hoofd gevangeniswezen Tennessee stapt op na mislukte executie Christa Pike

en.title: Head of Tennessee Prison System Resigns After Failed Execution of Christa Pike
en.summary: Frank Strada, director of Tennessee's prison system, resigned following a failed execution of murder convict Christa Pike. Governor Bill Lee confirmed that Strada submitted his resignation.

stories.title: Fietsbroek moet vrouwen op Oktoberfest beschermen tegen filmen onder rokken

en.title: Cycling Shorts Distributed to Women at Oktoberfest to Prevent Upskirt Filming
en.summary: Munich's Oktoberfest organizers are distributing free cycling shorts to women at the Teufelsrad attraction to prevent unauthorized filming under their traditional skirts. The distribution follows discovery of thousands of such videos circulating on social media.

stories.title: Politie houdt man aan na dodelijke schietpartij bij Vondelpark in Amsterdam

en.title: Police Arrest Man Following Deadly Shooting Near Vondelpark in Amsterdam
en.summary: A man was arrested in connection with a fatal shooting incident that occurred near Vondelpark in Amsterdam.

stories.title: Eerste kooigevecht tussen mens en robot eindigt in zege voor de automaat én verbod door autoriteiten in VS

en.title: First Cage Fight Between Human and Robot Ends in Machine Victory and US Ban
en.summary: The first cage fight between a human and a robot resulted in a win for the robot, prompting authorities in the United States to impose a ban on such contests.
